description: Control shows raw technical errors for connectivity problems: 'Failed to fetch' (browser fetch error) when the Pardner service is down, and 'Last T3 pass failed: No conclusive T3 reply to tools/call' when T3 stops answering.
expected: 'Pardner's local service isn't responding; showing the last known state' and 'T3 isn't answering at http://127.0.0.1:47390; showing the last read from 12:02'.
suggested_fix: Map fetch TypeErrors and T3 transport failures to human copy that includes the address. Suppress the pane error while the app-level disconnected banner is shown.

criterion: Information stated once / one way per task
description: When the service is down, the same fact appears four times (header 'Local service disconnected', app banner, pane 'Failed to fetch', each freshness label) and there are two retry controls ('Retry connection', 'Read T3 now'). Read T3 now does nothing visible while the service is down.
expected: The app-level banner owns the outage, and Control shows only the stale labels, with Read T3 now disabled until reconnected.
actual: Duplicate statements and duplicate retry affordances.
suggested_fix: Let the global connection state suppress the Control pane error box and disable Read T3 now.
